vendor_category_name,t.subsidiary_id,t.transaction_id AS transaction_id,date_trunc('month',t.accounting_period_ending)::DATE analysis_month,try_cast(tr.transaction_date AS DATE) transaction_date,t.converted_amount,t.account_type_name,abs(t.converted_amount) amount,CASE WHEN t.account_type_name='AcctPay' AND t.converted_amount<0 THEN abs(t.converted_amount) ELSE 0 END payable_amount,CASE WHEN t.account_type_name IN ('Expense','COGS') THEN abs(t.converted_amount) ELSE 0 END expense_amount, date_diff('day',coalesce(try_cast(tr.due_date_at AS DATE),try_cast(tr.transaction_date AS DATE)),DATE '2025-10-14') days_from_due_date FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l ON ('AcctPay','Expense','COGS')), agg AS (SELECT vendor_id,vendor_name,vendor_email,vendor_category_name,subsidiary_id,sum(coalesce(payable_amount,0)+coalesce(expense_amount,0)) total_vendor_spend,sum(coalesce(payable_amount,0)) total_payables,sum(coalesce(expense_amount,0)) total_expenses,avg(payable_amount) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0) avg_payable_amount,max(coalesce(payable_amount,0)+coalesce(expense_amount,0)) max_transaction_amount,count(DISTINCT transaction_id) total_transactions,count(DISTINCT analysis_month) active_months,min(transaction_date) first_transaction_date,max(transaction_date) last_transaction_date,date_diff('day',min(transaction_date),max(transaction_date)) vendor_relationship_days,avg(days_from_due_date) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0) avg_payment_delay,count(*) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0 AND days_from_due_date>0) overdue_invoices,count(*) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0) total_payable_invoices,max(transaction_date) last_payment_date FROM tx GROUP BY ALL), ranked AS (SELECT *,percent_rank() OVER(ORDER BY total_vendor_spend) pct,overdue_invoices*100.0/nullif(total_payable_invoices,0) overdue_payment_percentage,total_vendor_spend/nullif(sum(total_vendor_spend) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id),0) spend_concentration_ratio,date_diff('day',last_transaction_date,DATE '2025-10-14') days_since_last_transaction FROM agg), assess AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN pct>=.9 THEN 'Critical Dependency' WHEN pct>=.7 THEN 'High Dependency' WHEN pct>=.5 THEN 'Medium Dependency' WHEN pct>=.3 THEN 'Low Dependency' ELSE 'Minimal Dependency' END dependency_level,CASE WHEN vendor_relationship_days>=730 AND active_months>=12 THEN 'Very Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days>=365 AND active_months>=6 THEN 'Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days>=180 AND active_months>=3 THEN 'Developing' WHEN vendor_relationship_days>=90 THEN 'New Relationship' ELSE 'Very New' END relationship_stability,CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=30 THEN 'Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=90 THEN 'Recent' WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=180 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Dormant' END activity_status FROM ranked), scored AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN dependency_level='Critical Dependency' THEN 30 WHEN dependency_level='High Dependency' THEN 20 WHEN dependency_level='Medium Dependency' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END+CASE WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>=50 THEN 25 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>=30 THEN 20 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>=15 THEN 15 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN spend_concentration_ratio>=.2 THEN 25 WHEN spend_concentration_ratio>=.1 THEN 15 WHEN spend_concentration_ratio>=.05 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END+CASE WHEN activity_status='Dormant' THEN 20 WHEN activity_status='Inactive' THEN 15 WHEN activity_status='Recent' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END vendor_risk_score FROM assess) SELECT vendor_id,vendor_name,vendor_email,vendor_category_name,subsidiary_id,total_vendor_spend,total_payables,total_expenses,avg_payable_amount,max_transaction_amount,total_transactions,active_months,vendor_relationship_days,avg_payment_delay,round(coalesce(overdue_payment_percentage,0),2)::FLOAT overdue_payment_percentage,overdue_invoices,total_payable_invoices,dependency_level,spend_concentration_ratio,relationship_stability,activity_status,vendor_risk_score,CASE WHEN vendor_risk_score>=70 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN vendor_risk_score>=50 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN vendor_risk_score>=30 THEN 'Low Risk' ELSE 'Minimal Risk' END risk_level,CASE WHEN dependency_level IN ('Critical Dependency','High Dependency') AND spend_concentration_ratio>=.1 THEN 'High Business Impact' WHEN dependency_level='Medium Dependency' AND total_vendor_spend>=10000 THEN 'Medium Business Impact' WHEN total_vendor_spend>=5000 THEN 'Low Business Impact' ELSE 'Minimal Business Impact' END business_impact_level,CASE WHEN dependency_level='Critical Dependency' AND relationship_stability IN ('Very Stable','Stable') THEN 'Strategic Partner' WHEN dependency_level IN ('High Dependency','Critical Dependency') THEN 'Key Supplier' WHEN dependency_level='Medium Dependency' THEN 'Important Supplier' WHEN dependency_level='Low Dependency' THEN 'Regular Supplier' ELSE 'Occasional Supplier' END supplier_tier,CASE WHEN dependency_level='Critical Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage>20 THEN 'Urgent' WHEN dependency_level IN ('Critical Dependency','High Dependency') THEN 'High Priority' WHEN dependency_level='Medium Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage>0 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>30 THEN 'Payment Focus' ELSE 'Standard Management' END management_priority,CASE WHEN vendor_risk_score>=70 AND dependency_level='Critical Dependency' THEN 'Diversify supplier base urgently' WHEN vendor_risk_score>=70 THEN 'Review vendor relationship and payment terms' WHEN dependency_level='Critical Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage>0 THEN 'Prioritize payment processing' WHEN spend_concentration_ratio>=.2 THEN 'Consider supplier diversification' WHEN overdue_payment_percentage>=30 THEN 'Improve payment processing' WHEN activity_status='Dormant' AND total_vendor_spend>0 THEN 'Review vendor status' ELSE 'Maintain current relationship' END recommended_action,'Standard purchase agreement' contract_recommendation,'Standard payment terms' payment_recommendation,first_transaction_date,last_transaction_date,days_since_last_transaction,DATE '2025-10-14' analysis_date,CASE WHEN subsidiary_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE md5(vendor_id||'_'||subsidiary_id||'_'||cast(DATE '2025-10-14' AS VARCHAR)) END vendor_risk_analysis_id FROM scored WHERE total_vendor_spend>0
